Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Would you be so kind as to direct this letter on to Miss [Frances Martin](/person/971).

The address on her letter was printed in some ‘old English type’ and after much consideration I decided that the word looked more like Carrara than anything else but the Post acknowledges no such place.

Thank you for your letter. I think this will suit us, but I will write on to [Miss Coleridge](/person/329).

If you do not hear in three or four days, consider that we consent[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: This means \'consent to the terms proposed for the volume publication of [Strolling Players](/book/229)\' which they had written together and which had been coming out in [MP](/periodical/52).
